text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Guhh...! Even in plushie form, Umamusume 
really are out of reach... One does not 
simply bring them home, does one...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Trainer, you didn't do 
anything wrong!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I have cast aside worldly desires like 
‘wanting to hug and pet them all over,’ 
but perhaps my training is still 
insufficient."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I'll accumulate more good karma, cleanse 
myself, and become an ota worthy of Paka 
Petit-chan!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
